literal.prompt: Из каких костей в основном состоит позвоночник?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The exact prompt is answerable from OpenStax 7.3 L31; vertebrae are the column bones, while its discs are not bones. Each named distractor is a different bone set, confirmed at 7.4 L30-L32,L41 and 8.2 L29-L30,L55-L57. The question asks the principal bony components, so one key is uniquely correct.

literalGroups.literal: Позвоночник состоит из позвонков и межпозвоночных дисков. Этот подвижный столб поддерживает голову, шею и тело и защищает спинной мозг.
literalGroups.primaryGround: OpenStax 7.3 L31 states vertebrae and discs together form the column, which supports head/neck/body and protects the cord. The explanation preserves these qualifications in two concise sentences.

literalGroups.literal: Рёбра образуют грудную клетку и сзади соединяются с грудными позвонками.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Ribs are the bones of the thoracic cage; they attach posteriorly to thoracic vertebrae. This adds a concrete fact about ribs and distinguishes them from the spine’s vertebral sequence.

literalGroups.literal: Фаланги — кости пальцев; в каждой кисти их четырнадцать.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Phalanges are the bones of the fingers and thumb; the hand contains 14. This is a concrete fact about the named distractor and avoids extending the note to unsupported toe details.

literalGroups.literal: Восемь костей запястья образуют основание кисти.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Eight carpal bones form the wrist/base of the hand. This is a concrete fact specifically about the named distractor.

literalGroups.literal: У взрослого человека к 24 позвонкам добавляются крестец и копчик, образованные сросшимися позвонками.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The correct-note fact goes beyond the asked identity and key: the adult column includes 24 vertebrae plus sacrum and coccyx formed by fused vertebrae. This is directly about the correct option.
